lines.beaver_en: Welcome. What brings you in today?
lines.learner: 요즘 편두통이 심해서 일을 못 할 지경이에요.
lines.en: My migraines are so bad lately I can barely work.
lines.roman: yojeum pyeondutongi simhaeseo ireul mot hal jigyeongieyo.

lines.beaver_en: Since when? Do you have any other symptoms?
lines.learner: 일주일 됐어요. 눈도 충혈되고 속이 쓰려요.
lines.en: About a week. My eyes are bloodshot and my stomach stings.
lines.roman: iljuil dwaesseoyo. nundo chunghyeoldoego sogi sseuryeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: When your stomach stings, do you get acid reflux?
lines.learner: 네, 밤마다 신물이 올라와서 불면증까지 생겼어요.
lines.en: Yes, reflux every night has even given me insomnia.
lines.roman: ne, bammada sinmuri ollawaseo bulmyeonjeungkkaji saenggyeosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are you under a lot of stress? How is your daily life?
lines.learner: 회사 일이 빠듯해서 매일 너무 고단해요.
lines.en: Work is so tight that I'm exhausted every day.
lines.roman: hoesa iri ppadeutaeseo maeil neomu godanhaeyo.

lines.beaver: 가족 중에 고혈압 있는 분이 계십니까?
lines.beaver_en: Does anyone in your family have high blood pressure?
lines.beaver_roman: gajok junge gohyeorap inneun buni gyesimnikka?
lines.en: My father has high blood pressure and diabetes.

lines.beaver_en: I see. Have you been hurt recently?
lines.learner: 부상은 없어요. 그런데 이도 시리고 치통이 있어요.
lines.en: No injuries. But my teeth are sensitive and I have a toothache.
lines.roman: busangeun eopseoyo. geureonde ido sirigo chitongi isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 치아는 치과에 가 보셔야 합니다. 또 있습니까?
lines.beaver_en: You should see a dentist for that. Anything else?
lines.beaver_roman: chianeun chigwae ga bosyeoya hamnida. tto itseumnikka?
lines.en: I've started losing hair too. Could it be incurable?

lines.beaver: 걱정 마세요. 스트레스로 생기는 경우가 많습니다.
lines.beaver_en: Don't worry. It's often caused by stress.
lines.beaver_roman: geokjeong maseyo. seuteureseuro saenggineun gyeonguga manseumnida.
lines.learner: 다행이네요. 무릎도 쑤시고 다리가 퉁퉁 부어요.
lines.en: What a relief. My knees ache and my legs are swollen.
lines.roman: dahaengineyo. mureupdo ssusigo dariga tungtung bueoyo.

lines.beaver_en: We'll check the cause with a blood test.
lines.en: Could I be infected with bacteria or a virus?

lines.beaver: 검사 결과를 보고 말씀드리겠습니다. 푹 쉬세요.
lines.beaver_en: I'll tell you after the results. Get plenty of rest.
lines.beaver_roman: geomsa gyeolgwareul bogo malsseumdeurigetseumnida. puk swiseyo.
lines.learner: 네, 몸에 탈이 나지 않게 조심할게요. 감사합니다.
lines.en: Okay, I'll take care not to get sick. Thank you.
lines.roman: ne, mome tari naji anke josimhalgeyo. gamsahamnida.
